upload_audio_id.title: Upload Audio Id

mureka/api/song/transcribe.description: Transcribes generated or uploaded music into a downloadable archive that can include MusicXML, PDF sheet music, and timestamped lyrics.

title.title: Title
title.description: Optional title used for the generated transcription files.

upload_audio_id.title: Upload Audio Id
upload_audio_id.description: Audio ID returned by /files/upload with purpose='audio'. Provide exactly one audio source.

audio_url.title: Audio Url
audio_url.description: Public HTTPS URL or data URI for an MP3, WAV, or M4A file between 10 seconds and 10 minutes and no larger than 100 MB. Provide exactly one audio source.

song_id.title: Song Id
song_id.description: Generated song ID from song_id in a /generate/song response. Provide exactly one audio source.

mureka/api/song/describe.description: Analyzes a song from an audio URL and returns a written description, identified instruments, genres, and descriptive tags.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.

audio_url.title: Audio Url
audio_url.description: Public HTTPS URL or data URI for an MP3 or M4A song to analyze, up to 10 MB.

nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni/audio.description: Audio reasoning variant of NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Nano Omni. 30B A3B hybrid Transformer-Mamba MoE - accepts audio plus a prompt and returns text.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text prompt to send to the model. English only.

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt to steer the model. Reasoning behavior is controlled by the separate `reasoning_mode` field.

audio_url.title: Audio URL
audio_url.description: URL of the audio clip to reason about. wav or mp3, max 50 minutes.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Lower is more deterministic.

enable_safety_checker.description: Whether to enable the safety checker.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

reasoning_mode.title: Reasoning Mode
reasoning_mode.description: Whether the model should emit an explicit reasoning trace. `no_think` returns a direct answer; `think` returns chain-of-thought followed by the final answer.
